description: A unique identifier for each individual sales transaction.
A unique identifier for the product involved in the sale, typically a foreign key to a product dimension.
A unique identifier for the vendor or supplier associated with the product sold, typically a foreign key to a vendor dimension.
A unique identifier for the location where the sale occurred, typically a foreign key to a location dimension.
A unique identifier for the sales channel (e.g., online, in-store, mobile), typically a foreign key to a channel dimension.
The calendar date of the sale, used for date-based analysis and joins to a date dimension.
The precise date and time when the sales transaction was recorded.
The number of units of the product sold in this transaction.
The gross revenue generated from the sale before any discounts or adjustments.
The profit margin generated from the sale, typically calculated as (selling price - cost) / selling price.
The total monetary value of the discount applied to this specific sales transaction.
The final amount paid by the customer for the sale after all discounts and adjustments.
The timestamp indicating when this sales record was first created in the system.
The timestamp indicating the last time this sales record was updated.
